description: Engine layer: make the agents emit REAL project files instead of prose, and add a real OpenAI-compatible LLM provider alongside the deterministic mock. This reworks the artifact model so a single role can produce MULTIPLE files (each with its own path + content), reworks the role system prompts to request actual code, updates MockLLMProvider to emit small but genuinely valid example files deterministically, adds an OpenAILLMProvider implementing the existing LLMProvider interface, and updates the engine tests. The Orchestrator stays structurally the same (provider injected; multi-role roster preserved). This feature is the foundation the UI feature (FEAT-002) builds on. Baseline is already green (typecheck + 10 tests + build all pass).
steps: Establish/confirm baseline first: run `NODE_OPTIONS= bun run typecheck`, `NODE_OPTIONS= bun test`, `NODE_OPTIONS= bun run build` and confirm all are green before changing anything.

In src/engine/types.ts, extend the artifact model to support a role producing MULTIPLE files. Introduce a `GeneratedFile` type `{ path: string; content: string; language?: string }`. Rework `ProjectArtifact` so each role's artifact carries an array of files, e.g. keep `path`, `kind`, `producedByRole`, `summary` and ADD `files: GeneratedFile[]`. Decide whether to keep `content` for backward-compat (recommended: derive it or keep it as a concatenated/preview string) — but the authoritative data must be the per-file `files` array with real paths. Update any dependent types/exports. Keep comments in pt-BR consistent with the file.

In src/engine/agents.ts, rework each role's `systemPrompt` so a real model is instructed to emit ACTUAL PROJECT FILES (real code with correct file paths), not prose reports. For example: architect emits schema/config files (e.g. db/schema.sql, project structure files), frontend emits .html/.tsx/.ts/.css components, backend emits server/API files (e.g. server/index.ts, routes), integrator emits glue/config/README and a short verification note. Make clear in the prompt that a role may emit several files, each delimited with its path, so the real provider's output can be parsed into GeneratedFile[]. Preserve the multi-role roster (Ada holds ['ceo','integrator']) and the data-driven role design.

In src/engine/providers/MockLLMProvider.ts, rework the deterministic builders so each role returns genuinely valid, small, copy-pastable example FILES (not prose). Keep it fully deterministic (role+prompt -> fixed output, no randomness, no network). The mock must emit output in the SAME delimited multi-file format the real provider is expected to produce, so a single parser can turn provider output into GeneratedFile[]. Ensure the files are real and valid for their type (e.g. a minimal valid package.json as JSON, a minimal valid index.html, a small .tsx component, a small server file, a small schema). Keep each role's output derived from the prompt and include a role-unique marker so tests can assert role-specific content.

Add a shared parser used by the engine to turn a provider's raw string completion into GeneratedFile[] (co-locate it where it makes sense, e.g. a small helper in the engine or providers directory). Both the mock and the real provider output must be parseable by it. The parser must be deterministic and must gracefully fall back to a single file if no file delimiters are found (so arbitrary real-model output never crashes the pipeline).

In src/engine/orchestrator.ts, update `addArtifact` and the run loop so each role's completion is parsed into GeneratedFile[] and stored on the ProjectArtifact.files array. Keep the Orchestrator's public shape and injection unchanged; keep passing context {plan, artifacts} downstream (artifacts now carry files). Keep the integrator finalization and logging behavior. Ensure the pipeline remains deterministic with the mock + stepDelayMs:0.

Add src/engine/providers/OpenAILLMProvider.ts: a class implementing the existing LLMProvider interface that POSTs to an OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoint (default https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions) with header Authorization: `Bearer <key>`, a configurable model (default a cheap modern model such as gpt-4o-mini), sending messages [{role:'system',content:req.system},{role:'user',content:req.prompt}] and returning data.choices[0].message.content. Constructor should accept the api key and optional { model, baseUrl } options. Use the DOM `fetch`/`Response` types (tsconfig lib includes DOM). Handle a non-ok HTTP response by throwing a clear Error. Do NOT read any key from a committed source or env default — the key is passed in by the caller. Include a concise pt-BR/English doc comment noting it needs network + a user-provided key and will not run in the sandbox.

Update src/engine/providers/MockLLMProvider.test.ts: adapt assertions to the new file-emitting mock. Keep deterministic assertions (same input -> same output). Assert that each role's output parses into >=1 GeneratedFile with a real path, that the files are role-appropriate (e.g. a role emits a file whose path/extension matches its responsibility), and that at least one emitted file is valid for its type (e.g. the package.json file parses as JSON). Preserve a determinism test and a per-role marker test.

Update src/engine/orchestrator.test.ts: adapt the artifact assertions to the multi-file model (artifacts now carry files[]). Keep: one task per execution role, all roles logged, every agent reaches done, done=true/phase=done at the end, determinism across two runs, snapshot streaming independence, and the 'broken orchestrator missing integrator rejects' test. Add/adjust an assertion that the final artifacts collectively contain multiple real files across roles. Ensure these tests would FAIL if the multi-file behavior were reverted (they must exercise files[], not just old prose fields).

Run `NODE_OPTIONS= bun run typecheck` and fix any type errors (extend src/types/react-shim.d.ts ONLY if a React API is newly used — unlikely in this engine-only feature). Run `NODE_OPTIONS= bun test` until all tests pass. Do NOT rebuild dist here (the UI feature will do the final rebuild); but a build run to confirm no bundler error is fine.
acceptance_criteria: `NODE_OPTIONS= bun test` passes all tests, including updated mock and orchestrator tests that assert the multi-file artifact model.
ProjectArtifact (src/engine/types.ts) carries a files array of GeneratedFile {path, content}, and the Orchestrator populates it from parsed provider output.

MockLLMProvider emits genuinely valid small example files per role (e.g. a package.json that parses as JSON, a valid index.html, a small .tsx), deterministically, in the same delimited format the real provider produces.

src/engine/providers/OpenAILLMProvider.ts exists, implements LLMProvider, posts to an OpenAI-compatible endpoint with Bearer auth and a configurable model (default gpt-4o-mini), and typechecks. No API key is hard-coded or committed.
The multi-role roster is preserved (Ada still holds ['ceo','integrator']) and the Orchestrator public shape/injection is unchanged.
Tests would fail if the multi-file behavior were reverted (they assert on files[], not only legacy prose).
verification: Run `NODE_OPTIONS= bun run typecheck` and confirm it exits 0.
Run `NODE_OPTIONS= bun test` and confirm all tests pass.
Run `NODE_OPTIONS= bun run build` and confirm it bundles with no error (dist regeneration + commit happens in FEAT-002).
Read MockLLMProvider output for one role and confirm the emitted file content is valid for its type (e.g. the package.json file is parseable JSON).
findings: Engine reworked to emit real multi-file artifacts. New types.ts GeneratedFile {path,content,language?}; ProjectArtifact now has files[] (authoritative) plus a derived content preview string. Added providers/fileFormat.ts: shared delimited format (=== FILE: path ===) with serializeGeneratedFiles + parseGeneratedFiles (graceful single-file fallback when no delimiters). MockLLMProvider now emits valid small files per role (package.json valid JSON, index.html, .tsx, server/*.ts, db/schema.sql, README.md, .env.example), deterministic. Role systemPrompts in agents.ts rewritten to request real files via shared FILE_FORMAT_INSTRUCTIONS; Ada multi-role ['ceo','integrator'] preserved. orchestrator.ts addArtifact parses raw completion into files[] (public shape/injection unchanged). Added providers/OpenAILLMProvider.ts implementing LLMProvider (Bearer auth, default gpt-4o-mini, configurable model/baseUrl, throws on non-ok; no key committed; cannot run in sandbox). Tests updated to assert on files[] (would fail if multi-file reverted). Extended bun-test-shim.d.ts with toBeGreaterThanOrEqual/toBeLessThanOrEqual (real bun:test matchers). Verified: NODE_OPTIONS= bun run typecheck exits 0; 13 tests pass; build succeeds. dist/main.js intentionally NOT rebuilt/committed (FEAT-002 owns the final rebuild). CRITICAL QUIRK confirmed: every bun/tsc command needs the NODE_OPTIONS= prefix.
